sentences.text:
Smt. Pinki Kanwar W/O Shri Vikram Singh ... vs Vikram Singh
S/O Shri Bhupendra Singh ... on 19 April, 2023

Author: Sameer Jain Bench: Sameer Jain [2023/RJJP/007202]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Civil Transfer Application No. 44/2021 Smt. Pinki Kanwar W/o Shri Vikram Singh D/o Shri Durgalal,
Aged About 26 Years, At Presently Residing At Laxmi Vihar Colony, Bundi City, Police Station Sadar Bundi, Bundi (Raj.)
 ----Petitioner  Versus Vikram Singh S/o Shri Bhupendra Singh, Resident Of Ward No.
18, Agency Area, Devli, District Tonk (Raj.)

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Pawan Kumar Verma with Mr. Mohit Kumar Sharma Mr. Tanu Jaiman For Respondent(s) : Mr. Atul Kumar Jain HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN Order 19/04/2023 1.

This transfer application has been filed by the applicant-wife under Section 24 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking transfer of Application No. 219/2020 titled as 'Vikram Singh Vs. Pinki Kanwar' filed by the respondent- husband from Family Court, Tonk to Family Court,
Bundi.

2. Heard the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties.
3.

Considering the contentions put forth by the learned counsel for the parties and considering that the applicant is presently residing in Bundi; that the applicant does not have the infrastructural support, in terms of family members, who can accompany her to court proceedings pending in Tonk; that multiple proceedings arising out of the marriage are pending [2023/RJJP/007202] (2 of 3) [CTA-44/2021] adjudication in Bundi, including cases under Section 498A, 406 IPC and Section 125 of CrPC; that the applicant-wife is financially deprived with no independent source of income;
that the applicant apprehends threat to her life at Tonk; considering the provisions of Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act and relying upon the judgments of the Apex Court in N.C.V. Aishwarya vs.
A.S. Saravana Karthik Sha: Civil Appeal No. 4894/2022, Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay & Ors.:
AIR 2002 SC 396, Rajni Kishor Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Pardeshi: (2005) 12 SCC 237, and Vaishali Shridhar Jagtap Vs. Shridhar Vishwanath Jagtap: AIR 2016 SC 3584, this Court is inclined to allow the present transfer application.

1 4.
Accordingly, the present transfer application is allowed.
Application No. 219/2020 be transferred from Family Court, Tonk to Family Court, Bundi.
5. Both parties are directed to appear before the transferee court on 20.05.2023.
By that time, the record of the case be transmitted to the transferee Court by the Court concerned.
It is made clear that if any of the parties would not appear on the date fixed by this Court, the transferee court would be at liberty to proceed in accordance with law.

6. It is expected that the transferee court shall dispose of the matter as expeditiously as possible;
preferably within the prescribed time period as stipulated in the Act.
7. Stay application and other pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.

[2023/RJJP/007202] (3 of 3) [CTA-44/2021]
8. Registrar (Judicial) is directed to supply a copy of this order to the concerned Court (Family Judge, Tonk), forthwith, for necessary compliance.
